answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus on developing a novel NLG model to produce a target sequence based on a given list of entities.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics. The performance is measured by standard corpus-level metrics, including BLEU, ROUGE.

answer_4.quote: We sample 50 examples from GIGAWORD test. Every generated news is presented to 5 annotators on Amazon Mechanical Trunk (AMT).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were presented with two news articles and asked to decide which one was better and which one was worse in order of grammar and fluency (is the news written in well-formed English?), coherence (does the news describe the whole event coherently?), and informativeness (does the news relate to the input entities?).
